title: Underworld: Live at Sydney Opera House
original_title: Underworld: Live at Sydney Opera House
overview: Electronic music legends Underworld returned to the Concert Hall for a euphoric series of sold-out shows during Vivid LIVE 2024. Featuring classic tracks from across their catalogue and never before seen behind-the-scenes footage, this unique concert film showcases why this iconic duo have stood the test of time over the past four decades.
